🎥🎬: Now You See Me: Now You Don’t (2025)

After years apart, the original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists—Charlie, Bosco, and June—for their most ambitious heist yet. Their target is Veronika Vanderberg, a powerful diamond heiress secretly using her business empire to launder money for dangerous criminals. 

The team sets their sights on the priceless Heart Diamond, using elaborate illusions, disguises, misdirection, and perfectly timed distractions to infiltrate Vanderberg’s operation. But when the plan goes wrong, the magicians find themselves hunted, captured, and forced to rely on one another to stay ahead of their enemies.

As the mystery surrounding Vanderberg deepens, the Horsemen discover that the entire operation has been part of an even bigger illusion. With betrayals, hidden identities, and one final trick, the team turns the tables and exposes the corruption behind the diamond empire—while a shocking reveal suggests their journey with The Eye is only beginning.
